visualCharacteristics: Row of bordered text cards with heading, description and a secondary-style link.
contentPattern: One row per card: optional image cell, then h3 heading, text paragraph and CTA paragraph (<strong> primary, <em> secondary).
usage: "Oft gesucht" (frequently searched) quick-access section on hub pages.
reuseGuidance: Use for text-only navigation cards; use tiles when each item leads with an image.
